question: What future event involving their fat and marrow is being anticipated?
premises: Fat and marrow are specified as substances.
Something is described as arising from those substances.
inference: When that happens, things born from their fat and marrow will come into being.
uncertainties: The exact referent of what is born from the fat and marrow is completed in the next verse.
plain_english: when it will come to pass, then things born from their fat and marrow
